ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark grey to black) surface. High-intensity pixels (white/light grey) are localized to approximately 15% of the total surface area, primarily clustered on the distal portion of the right lobe and trailing edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous black pigmentation occupies the majority of both lobes. Light grey/white mottling is concentrated in a large irregular blob in the outer third of the right lobe, with smaller, high-contrast focal spots following the trailing edge of both lobes toward the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped median notch with an estimated interior angle of 45 degrees; vertical depth of the notch is approximately 15% of the total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge. The right lobe edge displays higher pixel-amplitude variations (jaggedness) compared to the left lobe. Notable secondary notches are present on the right lobe edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edge from the notch to the distal tips, terminating in sharp, slightly upward-pointing lobe ends.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct, highly localized dark brown/black clusters of high-contrast pixel masses (biological colonization/barnacles) at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant clusters of brown/black parasitic or commensal organisms attached to the tips of both lobes; irregular serration pattern on the trailing edge of the right lobe suggests historical tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: The extreme distal tips of the fluke exhibit heavy, three-dimensional biological growth that significantly alters the natural silhouette of the fluke tips.
